test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In order to correct the situation of excess demand, which of the following monetary measures can be applied?

(A) Reduce repo rate.

(B) Reduce SLR.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neither A nor B**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Excess demand in an economy can lead to inflationary pressures.
 
• Monetary measures to correct excess demand typically involve tightening the money supply.
